farm_d476336945.title: Medium Irrigation Plan for Rice
farm_d476336945.notes:
Method: Drip
Action: Moderate soil moisture detected. Prepare for irrigation in 2-3 days, unless incoming rainfall forecast materializes.
Tip: Inspect root zone depth (15-30 cm) and apply organic mulching to conserve moisture in high temperatures.

farm_d476336945.title: Recommended Urea for Rice
farm_d476336945.notes:
Stage: Vegetative
Guidance: Apply Urea (46% N) in 2 to 3 split doses: 1/3 at basal, 1/3 at active tillering/vegetative, and 1/3 at panicle/booting stage. Avoid application immediately before heavy rainfall.
Safety: Excessive nitrogen leads to vegetative overgrowth, crop lodging, and increased susceptibility to insect pests like leaf folders.
